conversations: How many bones are in the human body?
An adult human body has 206 bones.
What is the largest organ in the human body?
The skin is the largest organ of the human body.
How much water should a person drink daily?
A general guideline is about 2 to 3 liters (8 cups) of water per day for adults.
What is the function of the human heart?
The heart pumps oxygenated blood throughout the circulatory system to supply tissues with nutrients.
